sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
The reservation module is the system for future bookings — if a guest calls today and books a room for next week, the entry happens here. It is an extension of Front Office: a reservation converts to check-in.

In Analysis HMS the reservation flow: Enquiry → Booking create (guest + room type + dates + advance) → Confirmation → Check-In in Front Office on arrival day → No-show/cancellation handling. OTA bookings are also pulled into this via the Channel Manager (in EXTRAs).
